rule_packs_approved_is_attributable.name: rule_packs_approved_is_attributable
rule_packs_approved_is_attributable.value:
"rule_packs"."status" NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'EFFECTIVE', 'SUPERSEDED')
          OR ("rule_packs"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "rule_packs"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "rule_packs"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL)

rule_sources_verification_is_attributabl.name: rule_sources_verification_is_attributable
rule_sources_verification_is_attributabl.value:
("rule_sources"."verified_by" IS NULL AND "rule_sources"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "rule_sources"."verification_method" IS NULL)
          OR ("rule_sources"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "rule_sources"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "rule_sources"."verification_method" IS NOT NULL)

pay_line_items_shape_matches_basis.name: pay_line_items_shape_matches_basis
pay_line_items_shape_matches_basis.value:
("pay_line_items"."quantity" IS NULL AND "pay_line_items"."rate_sen" IS NULL AND "pay_line_items"."amount_sen" IS NOT NULL)
          = ("pay_line_items"."basis_snap" IN ('AMOUNT', 'FIXED_MONTHLY'))

pay_line_items_quantity_shape_complete.name: pay_line_items_quantity_shape_complete
pay_line_items_quantity_shape_complete.value:
("pay_line_items"."basis_snap" IN ('AMOUNT', 'FIXED_MONTHLY'))
          OR ("pay_line_items"."quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "pay_line_items"."rate_sen" IS NOT NULL AND "pay_line_items"."amount_sen" IS NULL)

pcb_entries_verified_needs_amount_and_so.name: pcb_entries_verified_needs_amount_and_source
pcb_entries_verified_needs_amount_and_so.value: NOT "pcb_entries"."verified" OR ("pcb_entries"."pcb_amount_sen" IS NOT NULL AND "pcb_entries"."source" IS NOT NULL)
